effect_direction: higher miscarriage odds with additional preconception hot days; no clear association for the immediate pre-outcome window
effect_estimate: preconception/T1: OR 1.26 (95% CI 1.15-1.38); pre-outcome/T2: OR 0.94 (95% CI 0.73-1.20)
evidence_sentence: Each additional hot day during T1 was associated with a 26% higher odds of miscarriage (odds ratio: 1.26; 95% confidence interval: 1.15-1.38).
source_title: Maternal exposure to heat and its association with miscarriage in rural KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa: A population-based cohort study
